value.title: Phase 1: POC - build/run containers, compose stack, /health daemon (plan assets only)
value.summary: All work under docs/plans/002-docker-daemon-base/assets/poc/docker/ - zero collision with s001.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: "Prove the whole docker loop as throwaway POC: build container with named-volume cargo caches, minimal /health daemon, POC compose (db shape from s001 + daemon), db-safe reload loop, engine-agnostic lint, results writeup with timings and go/no-go for phase 2."

value.title: Build container: Dockerfile.build with pinned rust toolchain; build script (honours FS3_ENGINE, default docker) mounting source read-only + two NAMED cache volumes (cargo registry, target dir); builds the POC daemon for aarch64 linux from the mac host; cache/output volumes use EXPLICIT fixed names (compose declares them with `name:`/`external: true` so `engine run -v` and compose mount the SAME volumes despite compose's project-name prefixing); builds run `cargo build --locked`

Throwaway /health daemon: one minimal rust binary (single file, smallest dependency surface) answering GET /health with 200 {"status":"ok"} - no config, no other endpoints; Cargo.lock generated and kept in the POC crate (source is mounted read-only - cargo must never need to write it)

POC compose: db service copied from s001's shape (pgvector:pg16, named volume, healthcheck, distinct port) + daemon service running the built binary from a shared volume, local-only port binds; compose volume blocks pin explicit `name:` matching the build script's volumes, and the paved down NEVER deletes cache volumes (warm cache survives down/up)
Reload loop script: rebuild in the build container then restart ONLY the daemon service; prove the db container's StartedAt is unchanged across two consecutive reloads
Engine-agnostic proof: every script honours FS3_ENGINE; `compose config` validates the file; lint script greps for Docker-exclusive features (develop/watch, docker-only extensions) and passes
POC results writeup assets/poc/docker-results.md: cold vs warm build timings, reload timings, learnings, recommended phase-2 file layout and verb->script mapping, go/no-go verdict

tk-0101.assertion: file(1) on the output reports an ELF aarch64 executable, built from the mac host entirely inside the build container
after a 1-line source change, the containerized rebuild completes without recompiling dependencies; cold and warm timings recorded

tk-0102.assertion: curl inside the container network returns 200 {"status":"ok"} from /health

tk-0103.assertion: POC stack up green; /health reachable from the host; `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector` succeeds in the db service
db data survives stack down/up via the named volume

tk-0104.assertion: across two consecutive reload-script runs the db container StartedAt (engine inspect) is unchanged while the daemon container's changes

tk-0105.assertion: lint script exits 0; `compose config` validates; running any script with FS3_ENGINE=podman changes only the engine binary invoked (dry-run acceptable)

tk-0106.assertion: docker-results.md exists with timings table, learnings, phase-2 layout recommendation, and an explicit go/no-go
